response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS applications) and strong systems-level work in DLang handling millions of requests per second with async I/O and low-latency design, which maps conceptually to the pipeline performance demands of this role. However, his modern C++ experience is limited and dated (a brief 2014-2015 stint), he has no Rust, and he lacks direct navigation/routing or tile-generation experience, with recent years focused on TypeScript/Node full-stack product work.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial data platform experience as founder of GISCollective and Green Map GIS apps
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, fibers, caching)
Broad polyglot background with strong Linux, testing, and CI/CD craftsmanship
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience; no Rust
No direct navigation guidance, routing, or map-tile pipeline experience
Recent roles (2020-present) are web/full-stack TypeScript, away from systems programming
